title: Polynomial-Time Parameterized Linear Construction
statement: For every natural number $n$, the function that, on a bit string $z$, decodes its pair and applies the unary multiplication construction twice—first to the pair consisting of the word of $n$ ones and the head transducer output on the first component, then to the pair consisting of the decoded second component and the first multiplication output followed by $11$—is computable by a deterministic finite-state Turing machine in time $C(m+1)^c$ on every input of length $m$, for some natural numbers $C$ and $c$.
hypotheses_covered: The parameter $n$ is a natural number.
caveat: The supplied descriptions do not fully specify the head transducer and unary multiplication construction.
